summary:
Step 9 'Expected checkout to show one cart line item for the added product, not the 'Your Bag is Empty' message.' failed. Error: TEST FAILURE

Adding a selected product to the cart did not work — the Checkout page shows an empty bag after the booking flow.

- After selecting a size and date and clicking "Book Rental", the app navigated to the Checkout page.
- The Checkout page displays the message "YOUR BAG IS EMPTY" and an "Explore Collection" button instead of any cart line items.
- No product name or price line item is visible on the Checkout page (the expected product 'L'Aube Majestic Gown' and its price are absent).
